overview_description.description:
PROFITECH sarl is an established provider of class-leading solutions to major organisations in fast moving industries in the MEA. Focused on business improvement, our technology driven solutions deliver increased productivity and provide our clients with a competitive edge. Our partners are pioneering global technology leaders, our solutions implemented through a nationwide network of specialist installation 24/7 servicing, support and repair services.

PROFITECH offers a variety of image enhancing product to retailers, leading to a more structured and organized store display, giving the customer a unique shopping experience.
